kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتمع (form VIII)
# أَجْتَمِعُ (ʔajtamiʕu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# أَجْتَمِعَ (ʔajtamiʕa) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# أَجْتَمِعْ (ʔajtamiʕ) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.miʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
